decisions.briefing: Markets sold off sharply with NASDAQ down 2.1% and S&P 500 down 1.3%, putting us in a risk-off environment. No candidates are available on the screened list today, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash in reserve rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market weakness hit tech-heavy indices hardest today, with NASDAQ falling 2.1% versus a smaller 1.3% decline in the S&P 500, suggesting growth and tech stocks bore the brunt of the selling. This pattern typically reflects rising rate concerns or risk-aversion among investors rotating out of higher-beta names. With no strong buy signals emerging from the screener under these conditions, the prudent move is to preserve capital rather than chase a falling market.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍走弱，科技股為主的納斯達克指數下跌2.1%，跌幅明顯大於標普500指數的1.3%，顯示增長股及科技股承受較大沽壓。這種走勢通常反映市場對利率上升的憂慮，或投資者從高波動性股份轉向避險。由於今日篩選名單未見明確買入訊號，故選擇保留現金、按兵不動，是較審慎的做法。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly sell riskier assets like growth stocks and tech shares in favor of safer holdings, often triggered by economic worries or rate fears. On these days, it's usually better to hold your existing positions and avoid new purchases until the market shows clearer signs of stabilizing.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」(Risk-Off)日子是指投資者普遍沽售風險較高的資產，例如增長股及科技股，轉而持有較安全的資產，通常由經濟憂慮或加息擔憂所觸發。在這種日子，一般較穩健的做法是持有現有倉位，暫緩新增買入，直至市況出現較明確的穩定訊號。
